notes.title: Chapter IV Page updates & a story sneak peek!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

Exciting things afoot this week as the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124200/Nina_Aquila_Legal_Eagle_Chapter_IV_Sacred_Feathers/]NALE Chapter IV page[/url] has a new written description, all as part of our ongoing work towards release.

We'll have a release date for you soon, once our final few pieces of artwork are in place, but for now, here's the new blurb that gives you a sneak peek into the exciting next chapter in Nina's story:

[quote=author][i]It’s been several months since Nina defended the Rostro Racers in court, and Fledge City residents eagerly anticipate the next season of the home-grown streaming show hit: the magical girl sensation, Valkyrie: Sacred Feathers!

But when an on-set lover’s tiff takes a dark turn, Nina Aquila is tasked with defending Millia Nordin, the lead actress, in a murder case that defies explanation, even by the defendant herself.

North of the city, dissent grows as the Bikers of the Wastes are vanishing without a trace. Seeking answers, a lone rider saddles up for the long journey south, searching for the one man who she knows who can help her.

With Millia in custody, tension on the streets of Fledge City rises as each night brings with it unnatural, unexplainable events; disappearances, explosions, tales of monsters sighted in dark alleyways. Set on a journey where present fiction echoes the truth of the past, can Nina find the strength buried within herself to search for answers, and rise as the hero that Fledge City needs?

Lore meets the law for a war-between-worlds, with Fledge City’s courtroom as the fulcrum about which fate will turn!

Feathers will fly, wings unfurl, and light will shine amid the darkness… But before that, there’s gonna be magic, monsters and a whole load of sparkles.

Valkyrie… Transform![/i][/quote]

We're hoping you're all as excited about the upcoming release as we are! To make sure you don't miss out, click [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124200/Nina_Aquila_Legal_Eagle_Chapter_IV_Sacred_Feathers/?curator_clanid=42815562]here[/url][/b] to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2124200/Nina_Aquila_Legal_Eagle_Chapter_IV_Sacred_Feathers/?curator_clanid=42815562]WISHLIST[/url][/b] the game now! notes.title: Help me replace my office chair :(
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Coming to you with an unusually personal plea.

Much of the equipment I use for NALE development is bought on the thrift, as I try to keep costs really low in order to maximise the budget I can spend on making the games the best they can be.

Unfortunately, a couple of months ago the office chair I use developed a problem, and is finally giving up the ghost. I need to replace it as soon as possible before it becomes totally unusable.

This is a problem because I've suffered from lower back problems in the past, so I have to get good quality chairs. I'm also a plus-sized, fat-bodied person, which places some constraints on what I should get. I was very lucky to score this imitation Aeron chair on eBay ~5 years ago for an absolute steal, but I've been watching eBay for a similar bargain and just haven't found one.

While it's not the most exciting or sexy tool of the gamedev trade, I think people will agree that a working office chair is pretty vital in game development.

I want to look after my health and buy a quality chair with a long guarantee, so I want to buy a refurbished actual Herman Miller Aeron Chair, but these are £350, or ~$440. But I'm not comfortable with asking for donations, so instead, I'm putting my game on offer!

So during this period of the Steam Autumn Sale, I'm putting NALES1 at 50% off, and will be funnelling the earnings towards a purchase of a chair.

During this time, if you purchase the game, it will be a huge help. You can also purchase it as a gift either here or on Steam, if you already own the game. Finally, sharing a link in your social circle to the game and explaining this'll help out a one-person indie studio would mean a lot!

You can purchase the game in one of these places:

[list]
[*] Steam: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547290/Nina_Aquila_Legal_Eagle_Season_One/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547290/Nina_Aquila_Legal_Eagle_Season_One/[/url]

notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42815562/ff600da6dd81118b27cc244bd5e3feba32ab8d61.png[/img]

Hi all, happy new year and hope you've had a good start to 2023!

Just wanted to update you all on the state of Chapter IV, and a few other bits and pieces.

Chapter IV's written plan is in the late-stages now, with the plot essentially written, but with work to convert that into a development plan. Similar to how previous chapters were worked up, this involves breaking down the plot into a series of consecutive states, working out what assets are needed, and making sure the right evidence etc. exists at each point of the game. However, it's fair to say this process has "turned a corner" now and once this plan is complete, we can start map-making and scripting.

Additionally, watch out for NALE Season One showing up in a few exciting places... Unfortunately that's all we can say right now, but keep an eye out!

notes.title: ANNOUNCEMENT: v5 will launch on November 24th, 2021!
notes.notes:
Following a period of intense development to upgrade [i]Nina Aquila: Legal Eagle, Season One[/i] with the help of crowdfunds supplied by our community, we are happy to announce:

[h1]The v5 version of the game launches on November 24th, 2021, at noon CST, or 6pm UK time![/h1]

This newer version of the game will feature a wide range of improvements, which include...

[h2]Character busts for Anya Miller & Judge Tawny[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40675544/e87ef5a31cae8375ddafd1eb0fedf4f8fd398773.png[/img]

Thanks to our community, we were able to commission additional bust artwork for the characters of Anya Miller (in 3 outfits) and Judge Tawny. These were supplied by a new artist, Sincryart, who came highly recommended by @Koahri1, the artist behind our Nina & Hawke bust images.

You can see more of their work at...

https://www.instagram.com/sincryart/

[h2]Linux & Steam Deck support[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40675544/fca02a198c6901e6e9c9b27fc66205972f19555a.png[/img]

The game now supports Linux & Steam Deck, via a [b]native[/b] Linux binary (not via Proton or similar abstraction layer). As well as opening up NALE to Linux users, we've also already had the game running on a Steam Deck early devkit and the performance is looking great.

[h2]Name Cards for dialogue[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40675544/d380e1a8cda43bbc9a8e2f8e8afedfbc272ade93.png[/img]

At the request of many fans, we've now added namecards to in-game dialogue. These appear similar to the example above, for all "major" characters. Each one will only appear once the player reaches a point in the game where Nina is aware of the character's name.

[h2]Nina's major OBJECTION pose is now animated![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40675544/87bb284f886d424ce3d7d40df548d56636a85d65.gif[/img]

As in the example above, when players perform a major OBJECTION in court, Nina's image will now be animated, courtesy of @KJOEE88 over on Twitter!

[h2]Significant performance enhancements & small fixes[/h2]

NALE has been upgraded to use a much newer version of the nwjs framework, which means the game will perform significantly better on lower-spec machines, and should drop fewer frames on higher spec machines.

Also, thanks to our community, we were able to stamp out a bunch of smaller bugs & typos.

[h2]Get ready for NALES1 v5![/h2]

With all of these improvements, there's never been a better time to step into court in a world where all anime genres exist at once! Wishlist the game now, here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547290/Nina_Aquila_Legal_Eagle_Season_One/

notes.title: IMPORTANT: About Savedata with the upcoming v5 update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We're going to announce the launch date for NALES1's v5 update very soon.

However, we wanted to split this news out into its own update as it's really important for existing fans.

The v5 update is a significant upgrade to [i]Nina Aquila: Legal Eagle, Season One[/i], which will improve many aspects of the game.

After the update goes live, your unlocks in-game will be unaffected. This means if you've unlocked Chapter 2, Chapter 3 or the free-roam mode in-game, you'll still be able to select these when you load up the v5 version, and start from that point onwards.

However, these upgrades are so significant that the v5 version will [b]not[/b] be compatible with [b]savegames[/b] from older versions.

Steam Achievements are not affected by this.

In practice, when you first boot up v5, the game will inform you about the change, and prompt you to delete your older saves.

If, for some reason, you absolutely need your saves and want to stay on v4, you should set NALE in your Steam library to reject updates [b]right now[/b].

However, in doing so, you'll miss out on all the improvements coming in v5, such as more character busts, name-cards on the text boxes, Linux & Steam Deck support and more.

We apologise that this is necessary; we performed R&D to try and see if we could avert this requirement, however, it was simply impossible given the nature of the changes to the game.

We hope this won't inconvenience anyone too much, and that you're still looking forward to the new features of the v5 release! That announcement is coming very soon!

notes.title: Roadmap Progress - September 2021
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Just wanted to give you all a quick progress update about the v5 update later this year, following on from our roadmap post a little while back:

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1547290/announcements/detail/5291150756569323437

[h2]Linux Version is coming soon![/h2]
Fans will be happy to know that we have a fully running Linux version now, with only some minor issues that are being ironed out. This runs in a newer version of NodeJS (the Windows release will do this also) meaning that performance is much improved over, for example, the Windows release running via Proton.

Naturally, this is also the version of NALE that will take the game onto the upcoming Steam Deck!

We're not quite ready to release this yet but I think we're at a point where it's safe to confirm it [i]is[/i] coming, just a question of [i]when[/i]. We'll update you once we have a date.

[h2]Withdrawing support for Mac[/h2]
Due to updates to MacOS, RPG Maker MV is deprecating its Mac support, which affects the editor, but will soon have a knock-on effect on the games themselves.

https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/regarding-future-rpg-maker-mv-macos-support.139708/

Up until now, NALE hasn't had full Mac support (just the demo of Chapter 1 over on indie services, not Steam), but we had intended to support the platform in the future if revenue made it viable (we needed to purchase a Mac for development & testing).

The immediate result of this is that we will be removing the Mac version of the Chapter 1 episodic version of the game from itch.io, to prevent giving the false impression that future NALE content may appear on the platform.

We will not be releasing future versions of NALE for Mac OS, unless the above situation changes. We're sad to have to announce this, but at the same time, we want to be clear for those of you who were waiting for this (as several of you have asked in the past).

[h2]Art Update for v5[/h2]

[h2]Looking forward to the v5 release![/h2]
Thanks for reading this! We're looking forward to the v5 release, and will give you a date once we have one.

notes.title: We need your help to add Anya and Tawny busts to the v5 release!
notes.notes:
[b]Since the release of NINA AQUILA: LEGAL EAGLE, SEASON ONE on Steam on July 9th, we’ve been absolutely blown away by the response from the community – so many streams, tweets, reviews… But also, feedback. One of its major enhancements over prior episodic releases of the game were the character busts of Nina, Dylan and Chad, and you people said you wanted more! But we need YOUR help to make that possible.[/b]

Version 5 of the game (the released version is v4) is intended to go out in November. It’s our intent that this update will contain a number of improvements, such as native Linux support, running on an upgraded framework for better performance, and a range of smaller fixes like addressing some typos that slipped through the net on the first release.

However, the biggest change we intend to make is to add busts of Anya Miller & Judge Tawny to the game!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VKNas3j.png[/img]
[i]Left-to-right – sketch of Anya, final image of Nina, sketch of Judge Tawny, final image of Chad
These Anya & Tawny images are just initial sketches, but we wanted to give a little preview![/i]

These will include all three of Anya’s outfits (regular clothes, prison jumpsuit and catgirl attire) as well as Judge Tawny in her traditional judge’s robes, and will be completed in a similar style to the Nina, Chad & Dylan busts already present in-game.

These are made by a new artist, working under the guidance from our prior Nina/Chad bust artist, @Koahri1.

[h2]Why do you need help?[/h2]
As always with additional art, the biggest obstacle for NALE is cost; we need to pay for these assets to go into the game.

NINA AQUILA: LEGAL EAGLE, SEASON ONE on Steam has made $1115 in revenue to-date, which means we beat our revenue target of $1000 (the budget we spent to get the game ready for release), and had some additional funds to help offset some of our costs. However, we’re at a point now where we’ve made pretty much 0$. We’re “cost neutral”.

Although we’re really happy that we managed to do this, it makes it difficult for us to afford additional features or assets for updates.

NALE has never previously accepted donations. We don’t run a Patreon. We wanted players to be able to support the game by buying the game, so you (and us!) have certainty, when you’re giving us money, that you’re going to get what’s promised.

This is the first time we’ve ever tried to crowdfund anything for the project, but we’re hoping fans are okay with doing this because the end goal is so specific and quantifiable. We hope you’ll be up for this chance to support us and make a tangible improvement to the game (and because we know some of you really love Anya & Tawny’s characters, and have voiced that you’d like to see busts of them).

[h2]How do I help?[/h2]
In order to help pay for this, we’re trying to raise $500 from the community to cover some of the costs of the busts for Anya & Tawny.

You can help us in several ways.

From now until September 30th 2021, all revenue from NALE will go towards this target.

If we hit the target, that means we get the bust set for Anya & Tawny; if we go beyond the target, then we’ll look into adding more characters or some other art improvement. If we miss the target, we’ll still channel the money into NALE art – potentially just doing one character, or some other similar purpose that will improve v5.

To break it down, this means you can do any of the following to contribute:

[list]
[*] [url=https://ko-fi.com/tanukisama_studios]Donate[/url] via our Ko-Fi page
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547290/Nina_Aquila_Legal_Eagle_Season_One/]Buy[/url] NINA AQUILA: LEGAL EAGLE, SEASON ONE on Steam if you haven’t already
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547290/Nina_Aquila_Legal_Eagle_Season_One/]Buy[/url] NINA AQUILA: LEGAL EAGLE, SEASON ONE as a gift on Steam for someone else
[*] [url=https://www.teepublic.com/en-gb/user/nale]Buy[/url] any merch on the NALE Teepublic store
[/list]

We would really love it if fans considered the “Steam gift” option above, because this is great for twofold reasons – firstly, it contributes to the goal, but it also introduces NALE to whoever you give the gift!

Fans will be able to see our progress towards the goal over on Ko-Fi. The goal auto-magically ticks up when people donate via Ko-Fi, but we’ll also manually edit it to include the support via the other methods above. We’ll also periodically post progress on Twitter.

At present it looks like this:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rVP1u01.png[/img]

So we have 7 weeks to raise $500. Fingers crossed!

Thanks for reading this, and if you’re in a position to contribute, it’d be fantastic if you could help us out. But if you’ve read this far, whether you donate or not, we hope you’re enjoying the Steam release and continue to enjoy it with the upcoming v5!

notes.title: Game Updates Roadmap - Summer 2021
notes.notes:
Hi NALErs!

Now that we've out of our launch week, we wanted to make a post to talk about where we're going with NALE in the immediate future, just so you all have a window on the next versions of the game.

[h1]PLANNED FEATURES[/h1]
[h2]Update to version 5*[/h2]
Following release, fans have made us aware of a few small bugs. These were mainly typos, and little niggles that most players would not have noticed, so we've held off so-far.

Some of these changes, due to the way they change the game's script files, will require a savedata-wipe to go out with the update, as they would break your older saves, so our plan was to wait until the busy initial launch period was over. Be aware, this should not delete your unlocks, so if you've unlocked Chapter 2, 3 etc. then you'll still have those unlocked - just the actual savegame files will be wiped. We'll test extensively before we push this, because obviously we only want to mandate a data-wipe if it's absolutely necessary.

*FYI, the version live right now is v4. Versions 1-3 were prior to launch.

[h2]Linux Native Version & Steam Deck[/h2]
Following the announcement of Steam Deck, we asked for help from the Linux Gaming subreddit, who were enormously helpful. We've now had enough testing on the Windows version via Proton to be able to say, with some confidence, that the game will work on Steam Deck.

However, we also intend to publish a native Linux version of NALE S1 in the near future, if such a thing is possible, and we're going to start work on that in the next few days. We can't make any promises here as it simply may not be do-able given some of the weird stuff NALE does with plugins that extend the engine's functionality, but if we can do this, then we will. Watch this space for more info.

[h1]POSSIBLE FEATURES[/h1]
Okay, time to be frank. We know that no-one likes to think about revenue/economics, but there are a range of things we would like to do, but, realistically, could only do if the game's revenue permits. These are as follows:

[h2]Additional Character Bust Art - All Characters[/h2]
First, we want to address a bit of fan feedback; we've had a bunch of requests to replace all of the game's face-art to match Nina/Chad/Dylan for a more consistent style. We would love to do this, however, we would need an enormous jump in sales to make it possible.

To put it in perspective, NALE S1 presently has 56 busts, but many of those are variants with different costumes, meaning there are ~25 poses.

Contrast that with this - to do all speaking characters so-far featured would require ~250 images, many of which are unique poses. We're talking somewhere in the region of 5x the amount of art we produced for the Season One release, which, technically speaking, we still haven't fully paid off (we've paid the artists; I just mean that I, personally, am still "in the red" on this).

There's also the fact that we would need enough artists with enough time to provide the images, which will require organisation, though there's no reason to do that unless we have the money. We'll revisit this in the future if it ever becomes viable.

[h2]Additional Character Bust Art - Anya & the Judge[/h2]
However, depending on sales, we [i]may[/i] be able to get some more busts, so we're tentatively announcing that, if possible, we will try to get busts of Anya and Judge Tawny. This will depend also on artist availability.

Anya has 8 expressions, each with 3 variants (normal, prison jumpsuit, Aquila Channel catgirl).
Tawny has 8 expressions, with just 1 variant (Judge attire).

When the game "breaks even", we'll start a chart on the community section for this. NALE has, so-far, always been paid for with game sales, not crowd-funding or donations, and we want to try and maintain that approach if possible - so if people wish to support raising the money, which is entirely up to you - then we would recommend buying the game as a gift for friends on Steam.

We're not starting that campaign yet, but of course, if you [i]want[/i] to buy the game for friends, we won't stop you!

Watch this space for more info on that.

[h2]Localisation[/h2]
This is a big one. Ever since publishing the very first chapter-based versions of NALE, we've had requests to localise the game. The situation with this is similar to the above; it's all about what we can afford.

Our priority language is [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b], because we've had an overwhelming number of requests to support this language. We would also like to support Spanish & German, and potentially French, as these are widely used languages on Steam.

Russian and Simplified Chinese are a "maybe", because we are unsure if we can support the character-sets necessary. This will likely require software engineering which raises costs.

Ultimately we would like to see NALE available in any language that fans want. Just there are practicalities we have to consider from our perspective.

[h1]FUTURE CHAPTERS[/h1]
I'm sure a lot of you are reading to get more info on this. All we have to say at present is that, as a largely 1-man outfit, work on future chapters is on hold at present until the Season One release is well and truly wrapped up. This is partially because how things go with Season One has an effect on how we approach future content. We will update fans when we "break ground" on that.

[h1]Wrapping up[/h1]
Thanks again, everyone, for supporting NALE's Steam release!

We hope to have more info about the stuff above, very soon!

notes.title: Screenshot Derby 1!

As this is our first contest, there is no topic or brief; you can enter with screenshots of any part of the game. You can enter as many times as you want, though please try not to spam.

To enter, post your screenshot as its own post in the [i]Nina Aquila: Legal Eagle, Season One[/i] community. Screenshots only, no gifs! Also, you can watermark the shots etc. if you want, but please know that only raw screenshots of the game can be picked as the winner, so try to keep a raw version saved somewhere in case we pick yours!

The winner will be celebrated as the subject of a community post. We'll get in touch to get your info, then we'll create a post that links to your profiles/YouTube channel/Twitter (only caveat; NALE is a broadly SFW game so we won't link to explicitly pornographic materials).

Also, please be aware that any screenshots you post [i]might[/i] be used on NALE's store page in the future.

Good luck!
